why: The composition drops one axis: every preset inherits the authored delay, so `easy` is no slower to notice a hazard than `hard` is. Issue #223's monotonicity criterion fails on the axis that carries most of its behaviour, while the resolved config still LOOKS right -- the field is present, finite, and within its bounds, so every shape assertion in bot-difficulty.test.ts passes. The floor is kept in the replacement on purpose, so this tests the SCALING and not the clamp; the clamp has its own entry. Killed by the ordering test, which asserts strict inequalities across all three of #223's axes rather than mere difference.
killedBy: difficulty moves the whole hazard picture, monotonically orders every one of the three axes #223 added, easy -> normal -> hard
